correctness.rationale: The displayed tree mass-flow norm was reconstructed, with leaf flux c_i-c_{i+1}, spine flux c_{i+1} and the terminal branch. The molecular unit-ball reduction is valid for real free spaces; alternating sign changes attain 1+tail/a_l, while alternating selected starts attain the parity sum, with no lost terminal term. Nested 1-Lipschitz retractions give a monotone Schauder basis. Finite-section constants increase to infinite ones. Uniformly bounded tails imply N a_{l+N} <= sum_{i=l+1}^{l+N} a_i <= B a_l, hence q=1/2 for N>2B; block contraction implies bounded tails by geometric summation. An independently written checker evaluated all signs and selectors over molecules and solved the full Lipschitz-dual linear programs for three strictly decreasing rational combs (n=3,4,5), matching tree norms and both exact constants. The finite checks corroborate, rather than prove, the infinite equivalence.
